baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ... فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا ... قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A directed divine turn toward the upper domain becomes a spoken summons to the paired upper and lower domains; their answer repeats the coming-root and selects willing obedience.

activation_trace.role: Directed approach and intention anchor ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى as orientation toward the sky.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper member of the addressed pair.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the second addressee.
Audible or articulated saying frames both command and answer as a reciprocal exchange.
Coming and arrival join the imperative to its echoed fulfillment.
Willing obedience names one offered mode and then the mode the pair claims.
Being carried into an unwanted act supplies the coercive alternative that is not chosen in the reply.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a command for sky and earth to come.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a coordinated address to upper and lower creation whose mirrored saying and coming display immediate willing compliance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًۭا ... أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The command fixes the outcome, coming, while leaving two exhaustive modes for its realization; the answer collapses the modal fork into willing rather than compelled fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: The repeated arrival-root makes fulfillment common to both offered modes.
Agreement and mutual accommodation sharpen the affirmative mode selected by the pair.
Borne hardship supplies a second manner of fulfillment without supplying an escape from fulfillment.
The explicit reply makes the selection of mode part of the scene rather than a narrator's gloss.

changed_reading.before: Willingness and unwillingness are two possible outcomes.
changed_reading.after: Coming is inevitable; willingness and compulsion are alternative manners, and creation explicitly identifies its manner as concordant obedience.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sky is presented first as a visible material state, while the saying-root can denote a thing's indication; the dialogue can therefore remain real address and response while its answer is also legible in what the material pair does.

activation_trace.role: Rising smoke supplies a visible, mobile material condition before the command.
A thing's saying as its indication permits material behavior to function as articulate evidence.
Actual coming supplies the observable content of the answer.
Concordance makes the two domains' coordinated behavior a coherent joint response.

changed_reading.before: The smoke, sky, and earth are personified speakers.
changed_reading.after: Their speech may be both divinely enabled articulation and the readable indication furnished by coordinated material response.

baseline_models.mechanism: An unfinished smoky condition is brought into readiness: coming can name an affair becoming accessible or workable, and willingness can name capacity, so the answer marks availability for ordered function as well as motion.

activation_trace.role: Smoke rising from a source supplies the pre-ordered material state.
Straightness and completion supply an ordering pressure within the directed turn.
An affair's accessible approach and readiness recast coming as entry into an operable condition.
Capacity and ability make obedience an enabled readiness rather than sentiment alone.

changed_reading.before: Sky and earth move to a requested place.
changed_reading.after: The pair become available and capable for the ordered functions demanded of them, with locomotion remaining one possible part of that transition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ... لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ... قَالَتَآ
baseline_models.mechanism: Although the construction with إِلَى directly favors intentional approach, the equalizing branch of س و ي is activated by the explicitly paired sky and earth and their single dual answer, yielding a secondary image of high and low brought into coordinated balance.

activation_trace.role: Equalization between two things supplies the exploratory balancing mechanism.
The upper, overshadowing domain supplies one pole of the balance.
The lower domain opposed to sky supplies the other pole.
Mutual concord explains how the two poles operate as one responsive pair.

changed_reading.before: God turns toward two separately named objects.
changed_reading.after: The directional act also carries an exploratory image of coordinating the upper and lower poles into one balanced, concordant system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, delivered revelation meets nonhearing and a claimed barrier, followed by a command to become straight toward God. Against that sequence, sky and earth model the unobstructed reception, orientation, and enactment that human hearers withhold.

activation_trace.role: A delivered descent supplies the address that seeks reception in the surah's opening.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies what the majority fail to perform.
A barrier that prevents access supplies the human obstruction absent from the cosmic reply.
Straightness, balance, and upright alignment supply the requested human orientation toward God.
The focus's answered utterance supplies successful reception of address.
Willing obedience supplies the cosmic norm against which human nonhearing is read.

structural_cues: 41:2-6 moves from a delivered message through refusal, nonhearing, and barrier to the imperative فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ.
41:11 answers a divine imperative with the same movement toward a named endpoint and no intervening barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, failed hearing, a barrier, directed straightness, and the focus reply; I infer that the cosmic response functions as a reception benchmark. Alternatively, the opening human discourse and the creation scene may remain adjacent examples without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated creation dialogue.
changed_reading.after: The creation dialogue also establishes the surah's benchmark for how an addressed being receives, aligns with, and enacts divine speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding creation sequence places the focus between a measured, stabilized, provisioned earth and the completed differentiation of seven heavens with an assigned affair in each. The summons therefore functions as a commissioning hinge that brings prepared domains into their measured stations and tasks.

activation_trace.role: Creation as measuring and proportioning supplies the already ordered beginning of the sequence.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the earth's prepared structural condition.
Deliberate apportioning supplies the planning logic governing provisions.
Life-sustaining provision gives the earth a functional output before the focus.
Equality and equivalence make measured sufficiency an explicit pre-focus cue.
Crafted completion and executed action supply the post-focus outcome.
Binding demand supplies each heaven's differentiated commission.
Readiness and accessible entry let coming mediate between preparation and completed assignment.
Capacity makes the pair able participants in the commissioning transition.

structural_cues: 41:9-10 prepares the earth; 41:11 summons sky and earth; 41:12 completes seven heavens and assigns each its affair.
The initial ثُمَّ marks the focus as a sequenced transition rather than an unlocated creation statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation before, completion and assignment after, and a summons between them; I infer that coming means entry into assigned operation. Alternatively, it may remain literal compliance within a sequence whose functional details are supplied only afterward.

changed_reading.before: The command initiates an undifferentiated act of cosmic assembly.
changed_reading.after: The command is the commissioning hinge by which already prepared material domains enter measured, differentiated functions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messengers come to humans, but arrogance and a preferred blindness obstruct guidance. This sequence converts the focus's willing-versus-unwilling modes into an ethical contrast: arrival of address does not determine reception, and creatures disclose orientation by what they prefer and enact.

activation_trace.role: The messengers' actual arrival supplies a human-scale counterpart to the focus command to come.
Self-exalting greatness supplies the resistant posture opposed to willing obedience.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies an offered orientation rather than forced blindness.
Heart-fast preference supplies the mechanism by which blindness is selected over guidance.
The self's making an act easy supplies an inward dimension to willing response.
Aversion supplies the contrary orientation against which chosen concord becomes ethically legible.

structural_cues: 41:14-17 repeats arrival, address, refusal, guidance, and explicit preference after the focus scene.
The human actors are created within the obedient earth yet claim autonomous superior strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arriving messengers, arrogance, guidance, and preferred blindness; I infer that these human responses unpack the modal polarity in 41:11. Alternatively, طوعا and كرها may describe only cosmic efficacy, with the later preference language forming analogy rather than exposition.

changed_reading.before: The modal pair describes only how cosmic matter complies.
changed_reading.after: The pair also establishes a response grammar later exposed in human preference: address may arrive, yet the recipient reveals willingness or aversion through chosen orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's guaranteed coming in one of two modes becomes a template for later destination scenes: enemies are driven and held in ordered ranks toward fire, another comes secure on Resurrection Day, and the final meeting lies within complete divine encompassing.

activation_trace.role: Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies an eschatological form of compelled coming.
Organized restraint supplies the coercive ordering of the gathered group.
Coming on Resurrection Day repeats the focus movement in an explicitly final setting.
Secure inward rest supplies the positive manner of that later coming.
Two sides coming face to face supplies the surah's final horizon of arrival.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession removes any imagined outside to the summons.
Willing obedience supplies one manner of inevitable arrival.
Compulsion supplies the other manner manifested by driven gathering.

structural_cues: The surah moves from primordial cosmic coming in 41:11 to gathered enemies in 41:19, secure coming in 41:40, and the doubted meeting in 41:54.
Each later scene combines movement toward a destination with a sharply different condition of the mover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated arrival, driven gathering, security, meeting, and encompassing; I infer that they distribute the focus's two modalities across final destinations. Alternatively, the scenes may share inevitability without assigning each later condition directly to طوعا or كرها.

changed_reading.before: Willing or compelled coming belongs only to primordial creation.
changed_reading.after: The modal pair foreshadows a surah-wide law of arrival: the destination cannot be escaped, while concord or coercion determines the manner of approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and skins later testify, the skins answer a question, and their explanation attributes speech to the God who makes every thing speak and first created the humans. This makes the focus dialogue part of a wider ontology of divinely enabled nonhuman articulation and witness.

activation_trace.role: Declaration grounded in knowledge gives bodily faculties an evidentiary speaking role.
A thing's saying as disclosure lets the skins' answer illuminate the cosmic pair's answer.
Explicit speech, twice attributed to divine enabling, supplies the direct mechanism for nonhuman articulation.
Speaking indication preserves a materially legible mode alongside articulated speech.
Wholeness and complete inclusion expand the speaking capacity to every thing.
The knowable thing supplies the unrestricted class to which skins, sky, and earth belong.
Created existence links the later speaking bodies back to the focus creation scene.
The focus's command and dual answer supply the earlier nonhuman exchange.

structural_cues: 41:20-21 repeats question, answer, and divine causation of speech with body parts as the speakers.
The phrase أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ makes the later scene explicitly general rather than an isolated bodily marvel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies divinely enabled speech for every thing; I infer that sky and earth are earlier instances of that capacity. A live alternative remains between acoustic articulation and state-based indication, because the supplied نطق and قول branches support both.

changed_reading.before: Sky and earth speak by an exceptional poetic personification.
changed_reading.after: Their answer instantiates a surah-wide capacity by which God makes nonhuman created things articulate or evidentially disclose their response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who say that their Lord is God and then become straight receive descending angels; the best speaker later calls, acts well, and says he belongs among those who surrender. This mirrors the focus's sequence of saying, directed alignment, coming, and declared obedience at a human ethical scale.

activation_trace.role: Saying as professed belief gives the human reply a committed rather than merely vocal force.
Straightness, balance, and uprightness supply the embodied continuation of the confession.
Angelic descent supplies a responsive movement meeting the humans' steadfast orientation.
Handing over and relinquishing supply the human counterpart to declared cosmic obedience.
Directed orientation supplies the cosmic side of the mirrored alignment.
Saying as stance or belief lets أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ function as a declared identity.
Obedient enactment supplies the cosmic prototype for steadfast human submission.

structural_cues: 41:30 has the marked sequence قَالُوا۟ ... ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ ... تَتَنَزَّلُ, echoing the focus's saying, ثُمَّ, directed alignment, and movement.
41:33 joins excellent speech, calling, action, and the declaration of being among the submitters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close sequence of confession, ثُمَّ, straightness, and descent plus a later submission declaration; I infer a human enactment of the focus response. Alternatively, the lexical recurrence may establish thematic affinity without making 41:11 a formal prototype.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic reply simply records compliance at creation.
changed_reading.after: The reply becomes an archetype of professed allegiance made straight in action, later available to human responders and met by descending aid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun and moon are signs not to be worshipped; worship is redirected to their Creator, while beings near God glorify without weariness even if humans act arrogantly. The focus's speaking cosmic domains are therefore agents within worship, never rival objects of it.

activation_trace.role: Lowering and submission distinguish forbidden prostration to cosmic objects from prostration to God.
Created status places the celestial signs on the responding side of the relation.
Human self-exaltation supplies the refusal that does not interrupt cosmic worship.
Continuous glorifying worship supplies the enduring form of willing cosmic service.
Willing obedience identifies sky and earth as worshippers under command.

structural_cues: 41:37 names night, day, sun, and moon as signs and explicitly redirects prostration from them to their Creator.
41:38 contrasts human arrogance with uninterrupted glorification by beings near God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created celestial signs, redirected prostration, and continuous glorification; I infer that 41:11 locates cosmic agency inside worship rather than divinity. Alternatively, the focus may concern primordial compliance while 41:37-38 independently regulates later ritual behavior.

changed_reading.before: Personified sky and earth could appear as autonomous cosmic powers.
changed_reading.after: Their agency is explicitly creaturely and liturgical: they speak and act as willing worshippers within divine command, not as objects of worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later the earth is low and still, receives descending water, moves, rises, and lives. That ordered bodily sequence supplies a concrete continuation of the earth's answer: created matter expresses willing reception through responsive transformation and productive life.

activation_trace.role: Low, inert earth supplies the receptive state before activation.
Delivered descent supplies the water that addresses the earth materially.
Earth and plant moving with life supply the first enacted response.
Increase and rising supply the response's expansive development.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the productive completion of the response.
A thing's indicating statement lets the later material sequence be heard as the earth's continued answer.
Pasture and fruit becoming ready make productive responsiveness a branch-internal form of availability.

structural_cues: 41:39 gives a strict input-response sequence: low earth, descending water, movement, swelling, and life.
The same earth addressed in 41:11 is the grammatical subject of visibly responsive transformations later in the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the earth's physical response to water and focus branches for indicative saying and productive readiness; I infer that this later process enacts the earlier answer. Alternatively, 41:39 may function only as a resurrection sign rather than commentary on the focus dialogue.

changed_reading.before: The earth's willing answer is confined to a primordial spoken moment.
changed_reading.after: The answer is repeatedly embodied whenever earth receives a descending input and answers through movement, expansion, and life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans call for good, become desperate when harm reaches them, turn their side and move away under blessing, then expand prayer when evil touches them. This unstable, condition-dependent approach contrasts with the sky and earth's immediate and durable willingness.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies a human approach driven by desired good.
An effect reaching the person supplies the adverse condition that reverses the posture.
Good condition and favor supply the circumstance under which the human turns away.
Turning one's side supplies the withdrawal occurrence within the shared root record.
Distancing by the side turns withdrawal into an explicit spatial counter-movement.
Sideways separation and estrangement complete the image of moving away from address.
Renewed extended calling under harm supplies the opposite, need-driven orientation.
Purposeful direction toward an addressee supplies the stable orientation humans reverse.
Willing obedience supplies a response independent of favorable or harmful conditions.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeatedly alternates favorable and harmful conditions and records a corresponding reversal in human orientation.
The sideward withdrawal of 41:51 directly opposes the focus's directed turn and coming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies condition-dependent calling and sideward withdrawal; I infer that the focus pair's response is the stable opposite, not merely a quicker instance of the same behavior. Alternatively, the later anthropology may diagnose humans without intentionally contrasting cosmic constancy.

changed_reading.after: Cosmic willingness also exposes stable orientation: unlike humans, sky and earth do not approach only under need and withdraw when provisioned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise of visible signs across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear, followed by witness and complete encompassing, makes the focus's coordinated sky-earth response a horizon-scale testimony whose material order communicates beyond its original moment.

activation_trace.role: A manifest sign supplies the epistemic status of what is shown in creation.
Far horizons supply the spatial scale joining sky and earth.
Emergence into clarity supplies the effect of the displayed signs.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies what the signs disclose.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the closing evidentiary frame.
Complete encompassing knowledge guarantees that every material sign lies within the same witness.
A thing's saying through indication lets the cosmic event function as continuing testimony.
The overarching upper domain supplies the visible horizon field.
The lower domain completes the horizon-scale pair that bears witness.

structural_cues: 41:53 moves explicitly from signs in the far horizons to clarification of truth and divine witness.
41:54 closes with doubt about meeting enclosed by the assertion that God encompasses every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest horizon signs, clarification, witness, and encompassing; I infer that the focus dialogue is one such continuing cosmic testimony. Alternatively, 41:53 may point to other future disclosures while 41:11 remains only an earlier analogue.

changed_reading.before: The sky-earth answer is a completed report about origins.
changed_reading.after: The answer is also a persistent horizon-scale sign: ordered creation continues to disclose the truth its primordial response articulated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant و س م mapping for س م و and must not be rendered as a claim that سَمَاء lexically means a mark. It remains anchored in the focus sky, the later adorned sky, and manifest horizon-signs; downstream prose should present it only as a sign-bearing visual overlay.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark recasts the sky as a readable surface.
Repeated sky occurrences keep the marked-surface activation attached to the same cosmic object.
Displayed adornment supplies a visible inscription-like treatment of the nearest sky.
Manifest signs make visual readability a live function of the horizon.

changed_reading.before: The sky is only the elevated material addressee.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ordered and adorned sky also behaves as a marked surface whose visible features identify and testify to its ordering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it extends coming from immediate motion into ecological and reproductive output. It remains anchored in the focus branches for yielded growth and readiness and in 41:47's tightly grouped emergence, fruit, enclosure, carrying, and birth; downstream prose should call it a generative activation, not replace the imperative's ordinary sense of come.

activation_trace.role: The coming-forth of growth and yield supplies a generative mode of arrival.
Pasture and fruit becoming ready supply willing creation as productive availability.
Passing from inside to outside supplies the basic movement of latent output becoming manifest.
Ripe fruit supplies the earth's completed yield.
The plant's enclosing sheath supplies the boundary crossed by emergence.
Inner carrying and fruit supply the hidden phase of generative readiness.
Delivery by birth supplies the bodily completion of coming forth.

changed_reading.before: Coming is a single primordial movement performed by sky and earth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command inaugurates their continuing generativity as hidden potentials repeatedly ripen, emerge, and are delivered under divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it activates the packet's non-dominant س ط ع mapping under ط و ع, so it cannot be offered as the lexical meaning of طَوْعًا. It remains spatially anchored by rising smoke, the skyward direction, and the supplied branch of extension in air; downstream prose should retain it only as a visual latent image of the ordered transition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌۭ ... طَوْعًا

activation_trace.role: Smoke rising from a source supplies the material body of the vertical image.
Skyward-directed approach supplies the image's orientation.
Extension and elevation through the air supply an exploratory column-like shape.

changed_reading.before: Smoke is merely the sky's prior condition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse also evokes a rising atmospheric extension being taken up into an ordered sky-earth relation.

strongest_changes: The surrounding 41:9-12 sequence recasts the summons as a commissioning hinge between prepared earth and differentiated heavenly assignments.
The speaking skins and the statement that God makes every thing speak turn the focus dialogue into a general mode of nonhuman testimony.
Human nonhearing, chosen blindness, steadfast submission, and condition-dependent withdrawal make cosmic willingness the surah's benchmark for response.
The earth's later movement, swelling, and life show how an answer can be materially enacted rather than confined to a primordial utterance.
Gathered compulsion, secure coming, final meeting, and encompassing extend the willing-or-unwilling polarity toward eschatological arrival.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reactivated the focus through paired motifs of speech and hearing, approach and sideward withdrawal, descent and response, creaturely worship, bodily testimony, and horizon-signs. Split-root inventories also preserved controlled visual outliers without displacing the direct reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether saying-as-indication should supplement literal divinely enabled speech or merely describe its observable confirmation.
How much equalization can remain active under ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى when directed intention is the construction-near branch.
Whether the ecological and reproductive yield branches reveal a genuine continuing sense of cosmic coming or only a productive analogy.
Whether the later arrival and meeting scenes intentionally distribute طوعا and كرها or share only a broader motif of inevitable destination.
